explanation.en: Discarded clothing: “Most textiles end up in landfill or are burned”. Landfill means “buried”, and “burned” is the same → E.
explanation.kk: Тасталған киім: «Most textiles end up in landfill or are burned». Қоқыс полигоны — «buried», жағу — «burned» → E.
explanation.ru: Выброшенная одежда: «Most textiles end up in landfill or are burned». Свалка — это «buried», сжигание — «burned» → E.

RT-AC-MSE-06-Q1.quote: Most textiles end up in landfill or are burned

explanation.en: Blended fabrics “are difficult to separate” → C. G is about the machines, not the garments.
explanation.kk: Аралас маталар «are difficult to separate» → C. G киімге емес, машинаға қатысты.
explanation.ru: Смешанные ткани «are difficult to separate» → C. G относится к машинам, а не к одежде.

explanation.en: “most recycling machines can process only a single type of fibre” → G. The grammar helps too: “machines … can handle”.
explanation.kk: «most recycling machines can process only a single type of fibre» → G. Грамматика да меңзейді: «machines … can handle».
explanation.ru: «most recycling machines can process only a single type of fibre» → G. Грамматика тоже подсказывает: «machines … can handle».

RT-AC-MSE-06-Q3.quote: most recycling machines can process only a single type of fibre

explanation.en: “uses heat and water to separate cotton from polyester” → D. “Two materials” are cotton and polyester.
explanation.kk: «uses heat and water to separate cotton from polyester» → D. «Two materials» — мақта мен полиэстер.
explanation.ru: «uses heat and water to separate cotton from polyester» → D. «Two materials» — хлопок и полиэстер.

RT-AC-MSE-06-Q4.quote: a process that uses heat and water to separate cotton from polyester

explanation.en: Cheap garments “wear out quickly and are often too damaged to sell” → A. Selling abroad (F) is not in the text.
explanation.kk: Арзан киім «wear out quickly and are often too damaged to sell» → A. Басқа елге сату (F) мәтінде жоқ.
explanation.ru: Дешёвая одежда «wear out quickly and are often too damaged to sell» → A. F про продажу в другие страны в тексте нет.

RT-AC-MSE-06-Q5.quote: cheaper garments wear out quickly and are often too damaged to sell
